metadata.title: फिल्मों और म्यूजिक की दुनिया में उभरते आदिवासी  | Tribal Film Industry and Artists | Adivasi Heros
metadata.description:
You must all have seen or heard of Ranveer Singh starrer Gully Boy. That was the story of a young man rising from the slums of Mumbai to become a rap star. 

The Main Bhi Bharat team recently met some adivasi youths, who are doing the same thing in  Madhya Pradesh. We met some tribal children, and young men and women, who are building an adivasi music industry.. In this episode, we bring to you the story of these aspiring youth in their own words. 

#Adivasi_Music #gully_boy #Madhya_Pradesh
